Build prompt

Build “Custom Habit & Streak Tracker” on NeoApps for accountability partners. Let each person rename habits, check off a day and share a read-only streak with a partner. Keep records private to their owner and make any sharing opt-in. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

Check off Monday and Tuesday, then reload. The streak is two and the partner cannot edit it.
